description: GPS - Balades à vélo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Paris Sud. A little tired? If you have your head in the handlebars, Grand Paris Sud helps you to get back in the saddle by offering you family and new bike rides to discover remarkable and unknown places of the territory. “Key in hand” walks developed with the provelo 91 association. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud. The portal shows the English title as "GPS — Bike rides" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Paris Sud. Its keywords include velo, deplacements-transports, environnement, sport, balade. The listing shows 2021-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
